name: Time Greeting Pipeline (UAT)
description: Fetches current time, generates a greeting via LLM, and exports as JSON.

arguments.prompt: Create a one-line friendly greeting that incorporates this timestamp: {{fetch_time.datetime}}. Make it natural and conversational.
arguments.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant that creates brief, friendly greetings.

example_prompts: Create a greeting with current time
